## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link the issue: "Closes #123" -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] perf / refactor
- [ ] docs
- [ ] ci / build / chore

## How was it tested?

<!-- Commands run, scenarios tried, screenshots for interface changes (light and dark, desktop and phone). -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass
- [ ] Code is commented (module header, docstrings, comments explaining why), in English
- [ ] New user-visible texts exist in both `en` and `fr`
- [ ] Rights and audit are handled for every new action
- [ ] No secret, real domain or real IP address in code, tests or examples
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.en.md` **and** `README.fr.md` if user-visible)
- [ ] Breaking change? Marked with `!` in the title and described above
